text: We interrupt this program to bring you a special bulletin. Nonimaginaires, the brain fogs, are eating the Rusty Stack. Five pages are going gray above the clouds. Behind the fog is a dead air that swallows stories.
A silent keeper steps onto a deck that should not still be flying. Color is leaving the rivets. Spacey and Mira are arguing with a ship that answers in smoke.
A torn page. The freight hauler looked half dead. Her captain said the funny thing about half dead is you still got half left.
A torn page. One crate in the hold, stenciled like instruments, humming like a cat or a bomb. On this ship, humming means alive.
A torn page. A short round warlord met a void slime. The slime ate the crown, then the cape clasps, and left the warlord in his long johns.
A torn page. A garden city forgot how to float. Its lift crystals cracked, and every small ship in the sky took a rope and pulled.
A torn page. Cloud-farm goats on patched balloons, and a war that never ended because nobody could agree which sky was theirs.
We interrupt this deck. Sky pirates wrapped in fog. Grapples in the rail. The bow is the whole argument.
We take you to a city that is losing the sky. Three crystals have to sit down before the gardens can go on.
Special report from a cloud farm. The goats have balloons. The crystals have opinions. Sort them out.
Stand by for the crag. A fortress under a storm that does not move. The pages are in there with the fog.
Stand by for the hangar. Baron von Smash has fused with a Nonimaginaire. The axe is real. The face is not.
The pages are back in the book. Color returns to the Stack. We return you now to your regular program.
The next sky is already forgetting its name.
